children.name: Pennantia endlicheri Reissek
children.description: Known as the Norfolk Island brown beech, a tree of the family Pennantiaceae endemic to Norfolk Island. It grows as a large shrub or tree up to about 10 m with small white, functionally dioecious flowers, occurring in sheltered moist palm-valley and upland forest mainly within Norfolk Island National Park. Threatened by invasive weeds and rodent seed predation, it is assessed as Endangered under Australia's EPBC Act.
